Your voice. Your research. Your craft.

Manuscript. Analysis. Research.
One workspace.

Write and read your manuscript, explore its language patterns, and connect passages to research sources. Move between the text, its analysis, and linked dossiers in one workspace. You decide what to revise and share.

Meet Lixity ↓ Try a passage in browser →

Fictional English manuscript. Interactive read-only demo. No account or upload required.

Read a passage. Follow a source. Share a reading copy.

Move between a manuscript passage, its chapter comparisons, and linked research notes. Built-in analysis runs on your computer; optional speech, map services, and connected AI clients have separate network and data-handling requirements.

Available in v0.9.0: prose analysis, Direct Speech Mode, manuscript reading and editing, research dossiers, and reading exports. The public demo is read-only.

Read closely, with the measurements in context.

Read continuous prose, mark passages for review, and compare sentence lengths without losing your place. The built-in manuscript editor adds writing, local autosave, conflict detection, and undo.

Editor scope and availability (English)

Compare rhythm, dialogue, and repeated words.

Compare sentence lengths and dialogue proportions, inspect nearby word repetitions, and explore heuristic signals for speech, scene shifts, and character voices. Follow available evidence back to the prose. Built-in analysis runs offline; these signals support review, not a verdict on the writing.

Text-analysis workflow (English)

Keep scene research traceable.

Collect sources and notes, link source passages to claims, and keep author decisions alongside the manuscript. Maps and timelines help you explore places and dates. Retained versions preserve what you cited; they do not establish whether a claim is true.

Research, dossiers and evidence (English)

Print-ready PDFs and curated reading editions.

Choose a reading website or a printable PDF, from A4 proofs with correction margins and line numbers to mirrored A5 pages and submission sheets. Select the manuscript, companion notes, and analysis to include, with chapter limits and spoiler controls for reading websites.

Reading copy (English) · PDF & reading editions (English)
“

Inspect the signal. Make your own decision.

Measurements describe patterns in the supplied text. They do not grade literary quality or tell you how to rewrite a passage. Inspect the counted words and sentences, read them in context, and decide whether a difference matters.

How Lixity compares

Use Lixity to compare prose patterns, inspect the counted text, and trace research links while you read. It complements writing and planning tools; its measurements support your review and do not replace an editor.

Website measurement (English)

This public website uses GoatCounter to count page visits and named demo, installation, repository and PDF links. The adapter sends public page paths and event names, excluding query strings, fragments, form contents and manuscript selections. The local app and exported manuscript reports contain no such measurement.

Language and appearance choices are stored locally in this browser when storage is available. Browser language is used only to suggest a public introduction; it is not sent to a translation service or used to change manuscript analysis.

Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control disable collection. Counts are approximate and do not establish installations or active authors. GoatCounter receives technical request data; see its privacy information. For questions, use the contact below.
